{{Quote|You will go to the Dagobah system."<br />"Dagobah system?"<br />"There you will learn from Yoda, the Jedi Master who instructed me.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''Dagobah system''' was the home system of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. It was located in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. The various planets within this system, including Dagobah itself, included biting insects, which made carrying all-purpose antihistamine tablets and topical ointment during trips into this system strongly recommended.<ref name="Star Wars Intergalactic Passport" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dagobah system first appeared in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="Episode 5" /> The [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'',<ref name="htte">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> and its accompanying [[1992]] reference book ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'',<ref name="httes">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> placed [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] and its eponymous [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].<ref name="htte" /><ref name="httes" />
